QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Henesys in Ruins
QuestInfo.0: You talked with Chief Alex, and he's allowed you to stay in town for now. But why is #bFuture Henesys#k like this? Ask #bChief Alex#k about it.
QuestInfo.1:
According to Chief Alex, Empress Cygnus has fallen under the evil influence of the Black Mage and attacked Maple World, bringing Henesys to ruin.  

He said to talk to #bAthena Pierce#k if you want more details.
QuestInfo.2: You went to find Athena Pierce and ask her about the future.

0.msg: We've hardly seen anyone new here since #rthe attack#k. I can't promise you'll be safe here, but we do remember how to treat a guest. Rest up for now.

1.msg: #bTell me about the attack. How did Henesys end up in ruins?#k

2.msg: Hm? You been living under a rock someplace? You HAVE to know what happened here. #rThe Cygnus Knights attacked Victoria Island#k.

3.msg: #b...Did I hear that right? The Cygnus Knights...?#k

4.msg: You heard it right. It's all because of Cygnus that Henesys is like this. The Empress fell under the evil influence of the Black Mage and attacked us... That's when father lost his life and I became the chief.

5.msg: #bI can't believe it... Did the Cygnus Knights really do this?#k

6.msg: It might be hard to believe if you only know the Cygnus Knights of the past... but it's all true. Go and ask #bAthena Pierce#k about the exact story.

yes.0: Athena Pierce is no longer at the Bowman Instructional School, but in town preparing for further attacks. Go and talk to her.

no.0: Well, if you don't want to know the truth, there's nothing I can do, but you'll see it for yourself eventually.
